Easy Crêpe-Style Pancakes

Thin pancakes for a lazy breakfast.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 2 (makes 8)

Ingredients

  • 100 g plain flour
  • 2 large eggs
  • 300 ml whole milk
  • 1 tbsp butter, melted, plus extra for the pan
  • a pinch of salt
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and salt until smooth.
  2. Stir in the melted butter.
  3. Cook thin pancakes in a hot buttered pan, about 1 minute a side.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Spicy Tteokbokki

Chewy rice cakes in a sweet and fiery sauce.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

2

Ingredients

  • 500 g Korean rice cakes (tteok)
  • 2 tbsp gochujang
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 1 tbsp sugar
  • 2 spring onions, cut into 5 cm lengths
  • 500 ml water
  • 2 garlic cloves, minced
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Bring the water to the boil with the gochujang, soy sauce, sugar and garlic.
  2. Add the rice cakes and simmer for 10-12 minutes, stirring, until the sauce thickens.
  3. Stir in the spring onions and serve hot.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Classic Banana Bread

A moist loaf for overripe bananas.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

1 loaf (10 slices)

Ingredients

  • 3 ripe bananas, mashed
  • 1/3 cup melted butter
  • 3/4 cup packed brown sugar
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
  • Pinch of salt
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 175C and butter a loaf tin.
  2. Mix the bananas and melted butter.
  3. Stir in the sugar, egg and vanilla, then the baking soda, salt and flour.
  4. Bake for 55-60 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Weeknight Chicken Curry

A mild, creamy curry.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 4

Ingredients

  • 600 g boneless, skinless chicken thighs, diced
  • 1 large onion, chopped
  • 3 cloves garlic, grated
  • thumb-sized piece of ginger, grated
  • 2 tbsp medium curry powder
  • 400 ml can coconut milk
  • 1 tbsp vegetable oil
  • a handful of fresh coriander
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Fry the onion in the oil for 8 minutes.
  2. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
  3. Add the chicken and brown it.
  4. Pour in the coconut milk and simmer 25 minutes.
  5. Scatter with coriander.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Sticky Tofu Rice Bowls

A vegan bowl with crisp tofu.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 2

Ingredients

  • 2 tbsp vegan butter
  • 200 g firm tofu, cubed
  • 1 tbsp soy sauce
  • 250 g broccoli florets
  • 1 tsp toasted sesame oil
  • 200 g brown rice
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Cook the rice.
  2. Fry the tofu in the vegan butter until golden.
  3. Add the broccoli and soy sauce and toss for 4 minutes.
  4. Finish with sesame oil.

Smoky Shakshuka

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 2 · Ready in 30 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 1 onion, diced
  • 1 red pepper, sliced
  • 2 garlic cloves, crushed
  • 1 tsp ground cumin
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 2 x 400 g cans chopped tomatoes
  • 4 eggs
  • 50 g feta, crumbled
  • small bunch of parsley, chopped
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Soften the onion and pepper in the oil for 10 minutes.
  2. Add the garlic and spices, then the tomatoes; simmer 10 minutes.
  3. Make four wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6-8 minutes.
  4. Scatter with feta and parsley.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Nana's Leek and Potato Soup

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 4 · Takes about 45 minutes

Ingredients

  • 50 g butter
  • 3 leeks, trimmed and sliced
  • 2 medium potatoes (about 400 g), diced
  • 1 litre chicken stock
  • 150 ml double cream
  • freshly ground black pepper
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Melt the butter and sweat the leeks for 10 minutes.
  2. Add the potatoes and stock and simmer for 20 minutes.
  3. Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season with pepper.

Comments

Crispy Fish Tacos

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Makes 8 tacos (serves 4) · 25 minutes start to finish

Ingredients

  • 400 g cod fillets
  • 8 small corn tortillas
  • 1/4 red cabbage, finely shredded
  • 2 tbsp mayonnaise
  • 1 lime, juiced
  • 1 tsp chilli powder
  • 1 tbsp sriracha
  • 1 ripe avocado, sliced
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Rub the cod with chilli powder and grill for 8 minutes.
  2. Mix the mayonnaise, sriracha and lime juice.
  3. Warm the tortillas and fill with cabbage, flaked fish, avocado and the sauce.

Thai Green Chicken Curry

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 3 · 30 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2 tbsp Thai green curry paste
  • 1 stalk lemongrass, bruised
  • 4 kaffir lime leaves
  • 400 ml coconut milk
  • 300 g chicken breast, sliced
  • 1 tbsp fish sauce
  • 1 tsp brown sugar
  • 150 g green beans, halved
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Fry the curry paste in a splash of the coconut milk for 2 minutes.
  2. Add the rest of the coconut milk, lemongrass and lime leaves and bring to a simmer.
  3. Add the chicken and beans and cook 10 minutes.
  4. Season with fish sauce and sugar.

Comments

Made this tonight, loved it! - Sam

Lemon Herb Chicken Traybake

An easy Sunday traybake.

There is something about this dish that takes me straight back to my grandmother's kitchen. Before we get to it, a word from our sponsor: 20% off cast-iron pans this week! I have made this more times than I can count, tweaking it over the years.

Serves 4

Ingredients

  • 8 chicken thighs
  • 800 g potatoes, quartered
  • 3 carrots, chopped
  • 1 lemon, sliced
  • 2 tbsp olive oil
  • 2 sprigs rosemary
ADVERTISEMENT

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 200C.
  2. Toss everything in a roasting tin with the oil.
  3. Roast for 50 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is golden.
